description: Election Commission - Mr. Wajira Abeywardena Elected as a Member of Parliament
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically addresses the filling of a parliamentary vacancy due to a resignation, as governed by the Parliamentary Elections Act. It details the process of nominating and declaring a new Member of Parliament to fill the seat vacated by an individual who was appointed President. The content is centrally focused on an electoral process and the declaration of an election result (a new MP), which falls squarely under the Elections classification (Type 7).
